itemDisplayName: Azure SQL Hyperscale database with Microsoft Entra-only auth
description: Deploy a new Microsoft Entra-only SQL logical server and a paid provisioned Hyperscale database, with standard-series Gen5 compute, zero HA replicas, locally redundant backup storage, TLS 1.2, and one explicit SQL client IPv4 firewall rule.
summary: Deploy a paid provisioned Hyperscale database and Entra-only SQL server with a single-client firewall rule.
